# scripts

Build automation directory. Contains Bun compilation scripts for creating native executables from TypeScript source.

## Contents

### [build.ts](./build.ts)
Creates native executables using `bun build --compile`. Exports `buildBinary`, `getTargetPlatform`, `getVersion`, `main`.

## Configuration

VALID_TARGETS array: `bun-darwin-x64`, `bun-darwin-arm64`, `bun-linux-x64`, `bun-linux-arm64`, `bun-windows-x64`. BuildOptions interface accepts optional `target`, `output`, `verbose` fields.

## Behavioral Contracts

Default output path: `dist/llmux-v{version}-{platformSuffix}{extension}` where platformSuffix strips `bun-` prefix. Windows targets get `.exe` extension. Build command: `bun build --compile --target={target} src/index.ts --outfile={output}`. Build failure exits with code 1. Binary size displayed in MB after successful compile.
